c.tagline: Greenland's tiny Arctic capital - fjords, icebergs, and the northern lights at the edge of the world.

taxi.fareNote: No Uber or Bolt operate in Greenland - licensed local taxis are the only on-demand option. Book by phone (Nuuk Taxi +299 36 36 36 or Taxagut +299 32 13 21) or use a rank; fares are metered with a ~29.5 DKK base plus ~20 DKK per km.

emergency.note: 112 is the single emergency number for police, fire, and ambulance across Greenland.

english.label: Easy to get by in English

hood_landmark.Old Nuuk (Kolonihavnen): Nuuk Colonial Harbour Hans Egede House

avoid.reason: Weekend nights near downtown bars can get rowdy with heavy drinking; otherwise usual awareness.

hood_desc: The walkable commercial heart of the capital, home to the Katuaq Cultural Centre, shops, restaurants, and the main hotels; the natural base for first-time visitors.

The historic Colonial Harbour with Greenland's oldest buildings - the red Hans Egede House, the Church of Our Saviour, and the Greenland National Museum with its Qilakitsoq mummies; the most atmospheric, photogenic corner of town.
Nuuk's largest and most populated district of apartment blocks northwest of the centre near the airport; residential and local rather than touristy, with wide fjord views.
A newer, planned residential neighbourhood east of the centre across the bay, with modern housing and quick access to hiking trails; calm and family-oriented.
A quiet residential pocket in the city's northwest with sea views and easy reach of the surrounding mountains; suits travellers wanting a local, low-key stay.

water.note: Tap water is pristine and safe to drink.

transit.hours: Nuup Bussii buses run roughly 6:00 AM to midnight; taxis cover late nights.
transit.note: Nuuk's only public transport is the Nuup Bussii city bus network - there is no metro, tram, or train anywhere in Greenland. Most of the compact centre is walkable, and taxis (booked by phone) fill the gaps.
transit.pay: Pay the driver in cash (about 16 DKK a ride) or with a rechargeable Nuup Bussii card; contactless card is increasingly accepted on board.

ferry: Arctic Umiaq Line coastal ferry (seasonal, to other west-coast towns)
Local passenger boats and fjord tours

transit.m: Nuup Bussii city bus to the centre (~15 min); the new international terminal opened in November 2024
Taxi to the city centre (~10 min); no Uber or Bolt anywhere in Greenland

tip.r: Service is included; tipping is not customary or expected in Greenland, though rounding up for good service is fine.
